photos.name: finished-loaf
photos.summary: Halved loaf held up showing crumb and crust side-by-side. Open, irregular crumb with good hole structure. Golden-brown crust with visible banneton ring pattern and defined ear. Second half rests on white cutting board.

photos.name: scoring-pre-bake
photos.summary: Overhead crumb shot — loaf halved on counter. Open, airy crumb with mix of large and medium holes throughout. Even distribution, no dense patches. Good evidence of proper fermentation and shaping.
